how: Claude agent reading of the stored title + abstract, blind to the curated graph, with EXTRACT_INSTRUCTIONS and CLAIM_SCHEMA

claims.quote: These results indicate that SYNGAP1 disruption is a cause of autosomal dominant nonsyndromic mental retardation.
We sequenced the autosomal gene SYNGAP1, which encodes a ras GTPase-activating protein that is critical for cognition and synapse function, in 94 patients with nonsyndromic mental retardation.
